notices.title: Storm damage and closures
notices.text: Official notices flag rain damage, Arrow River Bridges closure between Tobins Bridge and Whitechapel Road, the northern Lake Hayes bridge closure, flooding at Lower Shotover and a Bush Creek closure. Affected named trails are excluded conservatively, including open portions where the closure boundary has not been mapped.

notices.title: Frankton Track works
notices.text: The normal Frankton Track is excluded. The signed 2026 footpath detour still has an unmapped gap in our earlier survey; use its separate partial map and follow signs. No continuous detour is invented.

notices.title: Twin Rivers review
notices.text: A detour notice near Shotover Delta appears on the trail index. Twin Rivers is excluded until the affected section and alternative are verified.

notices.title: Everyday riding scope
notices.text: Shotover Gorge includes Grade 3 and 4 sections and is excluded from this everyday planner, along with mapped technical MTB tracks. Trail membership is not a guarantee of easy riding.
